content_of_post_to_answer: How can I stop a repetitive mistake?
answer: Repetitive mistakes are rarely caused by not knowing better; they usually happen because the same trigger leads to the same automatic response. Instead of asking “why do I keep failing?”, examine the moment just before the mistake: the emotion, assumption, shortcut, or environment that sets it up. Change the system around the behavior, not just your intention. A mistake repeated is often a pattern asking to be redesigned, not a character flaw asking to be judged.
